description: Land Acquisition - Rescined the Declaration under Section 05 of the Ext. Gaz. No. 1859/09 dated 22.04.2014
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition matters. It specifically contains a declaration under Section 5 of The Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460) regarding the rescission of a previous land acquisition declaration. The document is published in the "LANDS" section of the gazette and deals with legal procedures related to land acquisition, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
